union ColorMode
  case light constant
  case dark constant

environment colorMode: ColorMode =
  ColorMode.light

record TextColors
  normal: @nx/color/color.nx:Color required
  muted: @nx/color/color.nx:Color required
  disabled: @nx/color/color.nx:Color required

  surface: @nx/color/color.nx:Color required
  surfaceMuted: @nx/color/color.nx:Color required
  text: TextColors required
  border: @nx/color/color.nx:Color required

  onAccent: @nx/color/color.nx:Color required
  danger: @nx/color/color.nx:Color required
  onDanger: @nx/color/color.nx:Color required

  onWarning: @nx/color/color.nx:Color required

  onSuccess: @nx/color/color.nx:Color required

environment color: SemanticColors =
  if env.colorMode is
    ColorMode.light =>
      <SemanticColors background=<@nx/color/color.nx:Color.srgb r=1.0 g=1.0 b=1.0 alpha=1.0 /> surface=<@nx/color/color.nx:Color.srgb r=1.0 g=1.0 b=1.0 alpha=1.0 /> surfaceMuted=@nx/design/palette.nx:standardPalette.gray100 text=<TextColors normal=@nx/design/palette.nx:standardPalette.gray900 muted=@nx/design/palette.nx:standardPalette.gray500 disabled=@nx/design/palette.nx:standardPalette.gray400 /> border=@nx/design/palette.nx:standardPalette.gray200 focus=@nx/design/palette.nx:standardPalette.blue500 accent=@nx/design/palette.nx:standardPalette.blue600 onAccent=<@nx/color/color.nx:Color.srgb r=1.0 g=1.0 b=1.0 alpha=1.0 /> danger=@nx/design/palette.nx:standardPalette.red600 onDanger=<@nx/color/color.nx:Color.srgb r=1.0 g=1.0 b=1.0 alpha=1.0 /> warning=@nx/design/palette.nx:standardPalette.amber500 onWarning=@nx/design/palette.nx:standardPalette.gray950 success=@nx/design/palette.nx:standardPalette.green700 onSuccess=<@nx/color/color.nx:Color.srgb r=1.0 g=1.0 b=1.0 alpha=1.0 /> />
    ColorMode.dark =>
      <SemanticColors background=@nx/design/palette.nx:standardPalette.gray950 surface=@nx/design/palette.nx:standardPalette.gray900 surfaceMuted=@nx/design/palette.nx:standardPalette.gray800 text=<TextColors normal=@nx/design/palette.nx:standardPalette.gray50 muted=@nx/design/palette.nx:standardPalette.gray400 disabled=@nx/design/palette.nx:standardPalette.gray600 /> border=@nx/design/palette.nx:standardPalette.gray800 focus=@nx/design/palette.nx:standardPalette.blue400 accent=@nx/design/palette.nx:standardPalette.blue400 onAccent=@nx/design/palette.nx:standardPalette.gray950 danger=@nx/design/palette.nx:standardPalette.red500 onDanger=@nx/design/palette.nx:standardPalette.gray950 warning=@nx/design/palette.nx:standardPalette.amber400 onWarning=@nx/design/palette.nx:standardPalette.gray950 success=@nx/design/palette.nx:standardPalette.green500 onSuccess=@nx/design/palette.nx:standardPalette.gray950 />
